captions.detailed: This 3D model is a stackable CD holder arm designed as a single physical part. It consists of a vertical stackable cylindrical base on one end, featuring a narrower top peg with a conical tip to facilitate stacking. A horizontal connecting shaft extends from this base to a CD pole structure on the opposite end, which features a flared conical base, a cylindrical pole section, and a small conical cap to securely hold a CD.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, stackable CD holder in OpenSCAD. The part should feature a stackable vertical cylinder on one end with a conical alignment tip, a connecting shaft, and a CD pole on the other end with a flared base. Include parameters for the stackable base height and width, shaft length and width, and CD pole dimensions.
captions.factory: The script defines several modular components: 'top' creates a cylinder and a cone on top; 'stackable' creates a hollowed-out cylindrical base by subtracting a tolerance-scaled 'top' from a cylinder, and then adds a 'top' to the upper surface; 'shaft' creates a horizontal connecting beam by rotating and subtracting cubes to achieve a triangular or diamond profile; 'cdPole' creates a flared hollow cone base and a cylindrical pole with a conical cap. These components are combined using translate and union operations to assemble the final CD holder.
